top_10_facts.fact: Lumentum reported fiscal Q4 2026 net revenue of $1.01 billion with GAAP gross margin of 47.4% and non-GAAP gross margin of 50.4%.
Lumentum guided fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion, non-GAAP operating margin of 39.5% to 40.5%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.05 to $4.35.
Lumentum cited OCS solutions, cloud module business with 1.6T adoption, ultra-high-power CPO lasers, and an initial order for ELS modules as growth drivers.
Lumentum reported fiscal Q3 2026 net revenue of $808.4 million, GAAP gross margin of 44.2%, non-GAAP gross margin of 47.9%, GAAP operating margin of 21.6%, and non-GAAP operating margin of 32.2%.
Lumentum's fiscal Q3 2026 revenue grew 90% year over year to a record $808 million, with gross margin up 540 basis points sequentially and operating margin up 700 basis points.
Lumentum attributed fiscal Q3 2026 margin improvement to operational rigor, pricing discipline, product mix, strength in laser chips, and 'scale-across' components.
Lumentum reported fiscal Q3 2026 GAAP diluted net income per share of $1.50 and non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $2.37.
Lumentum filed an 8-K with the SEC dated August 11, 2026.
Lumentum filed an 8-K with the SEC dated May 29, 2026.
